capability.summary: Return a fixed tab-separated recent Git log format inside a JSON process envelope
capability.description: Runs Git log for one required repository with a fixed short-hash, author, ISO date, and subject format. The optional digit-string max count defaults to 50; output remains unparsed text in stdout rather than structured log objects.
capability.problem_space: Read-only human-readable recent Git log text in one fixed tab-separated layout; not structured JSON records, arbitrary pretty-format execution, revision-range search, patch output, or history mutation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required existing repo_path and optional digit-string max_count defaulting/falling back to `50`; output: JSON envelope whose stdout contains fixed tab-separated Git log lines.
accepted_inputs: an existing local Git repository directory path
an optional non-negative digit string for the maximum commit count; non-digit text silently uses 50
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "git", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; each stdout line uses `<short hash>\t<author>\t<ISO date>\t<subject>`. Nonzero Git result uses the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagates Git's exit code. Non-existing repo, missing Git, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "git", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing repo argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: the pretty format is fixed to short hash, author display name, ISO date, and subject; callers cannot provide arbitrary Git format placeholders
returns unparsed tab-separated stdout with result=null rather than structured commit objects; use git_log_json for parsed fields
uses current default history traversal with no revision, branch, path, author, date-range, graph, body, stat, or patch options
non-digit max_count silently becomes 50; the wrapper uses a fixed 120-second timeout and no output truncation beyond the Git count

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope whose stdout contains fixed tab-separated recent Git log lines; no structured log array is produced.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: display recent Git commits in a fixed tab-separated format
get short hash author ISO date and subject log lines
negative_intents: use a caller-defined Git pretty format or revision range
inspect patches or modify Git history
